load_controlnet_model: load the PixArtControlNetAdapterModel from pretrained weights with float16 dtype and safetensors
build_controlnet_pipeline: build a PixArtAlphaControlnetPipeline from pretrained model with a ControlNet adapter
load_hed_edge_detector: load the HEDdetector from pretrained annotators for edge detection
load_image_from_file: load an image file using diffusers load_image utility
run_controlnet_generation: run the PixArtAlphaControlnetPipeline with a prompt and HED edge control image to generate output
